correctness.rationale: For any length n>=2, the dissipative path generator has no imaginary-axis eigenmode by endpoint recursion. The explicitly displayed Hermitian matrix satisfies gamma(PQ+QP)-i[H,Q]=I by direct four-neighbor cancellation, including every boundary and parity; Lyapunov uniqueness identifies it with the integrated survival operator. Trace pairing yields all mixed-state times, diagonal entries give each localized lifetime, and AM-GM gives the unique positive optimizer for a>=2. Standalone exact symbolic tests check 7475 rational residual matrix entries; 110 independent Lyapunov solves/1375 diagonal comparisons corroborate it. No infinite conclusion rests on finite tests.

value.rationale: Unlike generic inverse-Lyapunov existence or a one-off minimum from elementary calculus, the main formula evaluates every off-diagonal coherent interference term and every localized mean lifetime for an infinite sequence of path lengths. It reveals a physically motivated exact transport optimum independent of the unused far-end length, and separates weak-absorption from Zeno suppression regimes. The exact all-state operator is a useful reproducible input for coherent-source optimization and boundary-controlled transport; no unspecified downstream result is required.
